ops.title: Adopt or delete the unadopted ledger API (gateOpen, ledgers.parked, ledger.clear)
ops.description: Track B phase 7 found substrate API born in the redesign but never adopted by the ports: ledger.clear / ledger.gateOpen / ledgers.gateOpen / ledgers.parked are exercised only by ledger_test.go (production uses faulted/due/backoffElapsed/map-level clear/ledger.parked). gateOpen's doc implies an intended consumer (auth/ratelimit gates call weaker forms). Decide: wire the gate consumers through gateOpen, or delete the dead surface.

ops.text: each symbol either has a production caller or is deleted with its tests
